annotations.text: Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/0: Admission target: production workspace_agent_dispatch registration and admitAgentDispatchRequest accept the exact legitimate request at admission only; the real env.PATH dictionary value ../opaque-control.txt is schema-admitted, preserved and opaque to protected authority coordinates. Demonstrate this; do not add a field, change parser behavior, invoke its lazy continuation, or substitute a mock parser/resolver. If the control is not actually accepted, return the precise blocker.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/1: Refusal cut: the corresponding actual request plus registered authority:true returns caller_supplied_cce_policy_authority with the caller-supplied-identity blocker and authority in refused_fields before resolveWorkspaceRepo or any protected downstream continuation. Cover every incumbent forbidden-field family and precedence as regressions without extending this claim to WK-2510 policy selection, no-gate settlement or automatic review.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/2: Complete observation: derive the exact loaded admission dependency/callsite census and nine source channels (resolver, loader, filesystem, environment, module, catalog, subprocess, return, success), with actual source-specific start/end state/version and monotone refusal cut. Prove a real injected prohibited occurrence in each channel invalidates absence; missing hooks, missing/extra/duplicate source, endpoints, dropped/late/misordered events and stale module/schema generations must never produce success. Refusal output is not protected successful dispatch return.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/3: Production provenance: only live host-private acquisition objects yield exact request/outcome bytes and actual signed source assignment, target, source, attempt and authentication witnesses. Use randomly generated per-acquisition/source Ed25519 keys and successful signature verification over actual retained bytes; reject forged/mismatched keys, altered evidence, fixture-only synthetic witnesses and foreign source/attempt. No private keys persisted/exposed; no CCE, admission, launcher identity or general trust authority conferred.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/4: Existing pack composition: proof.input.caller-authority-confinement@2.0.0 consumes the five actual input artifacts and its incumbent caller-input-surface-capture.v1 alone creates caller-input-projection. Derive concrete-member input policy from the shared real schema/refusal owner; preserve open dictionary semantics, actual decoding/aliases and exact protected coordinate associations. Pure mapper reuses capture-mapping and owned vocabularies, never acts as acquisition or policy owner.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/13: Design/execution distinction: bind meaningful stable runtime test proofs with declared actual boundaries, observables and falsifiers. New tests have honest no_executed_coverage and no invented runtime identities until workers implement and execute them through launcher-supported validation. Review prose, local signatures, metadata completeness and pack stage never assert implementation readiness, CCE admissibility or completion.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/5: Single ownership: one package artifact naming/declaration owner replaces duplicate suffix/formula definitions; common-proof-capture-tools retains sole family/store/currentness/persistence dispatch and carrier-set-publication retains staging/exclusion/complete-generation publication. Existing other-family contracts remain correct without compatibility shims or independent file writes. Use actual structured size/attestation/refactor policy results, not the 1200-LOC retrieval threshold.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/6: Exact source selection: six artifacts plus public producer metadata are complete WK contract-generation constituents. Manifest owns shared locations/digests/lengths; private producer join additionally matches exact pack/profile, WK/focus, schema/parser/observer generation, acquisition/attempt/cut, requirement and intended artifact. Reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous/foreign/stale/tampered sources or wrong requirement-to-artifact association; filename, digest match or signature alone cannot confer intended identity.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/7: Atomicity and currentness: publish the complete constituent census under one incumbent source lease/CAS/generation/manifest switch; source movement or pre-switch failure preserves the canonical generation, while post-switch/indeterminate failures report truthful effects and supported recovery. Test same/conflicting replay, concurrent acquisition/publication and restart; never reconstruct unfinished observations or silently reuse stale captures.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/8: Private exact-capture handoff: absent-input authoring and applicable reauthoring/reference preparation receive only server-resolved authenticated source locations through the existing package constructor and incumbent applicability reassessment. Changed intent requires explicit current owner rebinding. Preserve unrelated carriers and compiler refusal for missing/stale exact_capture; no null-plan success, guessed path, generic lookup, pack substitution or auto-acquisition from refresh/post_delivery.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/9: Exact verifier consumption: real capture-generated declarations reach the unchanged exact-binding compiler/capture/verification owners with descriptor-pinned no-symlink regular-file containment and before/after identity checks. Missing sixth projection, invalid signatures, traversal, symlink/nonregular/replaced descriptor and change-during-read fail; a complete projected artifact alone is not proof of runtime truth or lifecycle completion.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/10: Bounded resources: before allocation/I/O enforce exactly two attempts/nine sources/six artifacts, 64 KiB per request, depth 16, 256 concrete declarations, 4096 events, 8 MiB per artifact and aggregate 48 MiB subject to stricter carrier-owner caps including witness overhead. At most one in-flight acquisition per WK/focus; discard incomplete process state at request end. Overflow/depth/size/count failures report unavailability rather than dropping data or proving absence.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/11: Public authority and effects: extend only coordinator/operator workspace_controlled_common_proof_capture with the exact caller-authority family and fixed server-side admission target. Server resolves/checks repo/WK/focus/profile/verification/role/write scope. Reject caller roots/paths/keys/evidence/policy/source assignments/requests/executors/environment before acquisition or writes; expose actual attempt/publication effects and bounded closed-code/redaction projections; do not give workers inherited execution capability.

Acceptance /acceptance/criteria/12: End-to-end integration and discovery: real registered capture to complete canonical generation to semantic absent-input authoring to reassessed reauthoring to exact verification succeeds in isolated integration tests, with exact expected negative cases and unchanged unrelated packs. Always-on discovery and owning docs disclose the only supported target, source caps/currentness, effects, refusal causes and next call; explicitly keep later WK-2510 policy/no-gate/automatic-review proofs separate.

The selected test-validity pack concerns WK-2518's implementation test population. It is not a substitute for the existing caller-authority-confinement consumer pack. Every stable-v1 runtime verification requires actual candidate/falsifier/traversal/inventory evidence after implementation; no runtime identities or results are invented.

Substantive pre_dispatch noninvocation model for AC2/AC3: the real authority:true admission request must not call resolveWorkspaceRepo or the returned lazy transition-selection continuation before its actual refusal. These two operations define this selected downstream barrier only; they are not a substitute for the complete nine-channel observation census, actual accepted control or production provenance. Population and verification bindings are declared design facts, not captured runtime evidence. All existing detailed criteria remain mandatory.

AC8 pre-switch failure sub-obligation only. Resolve the incumbent visible manifest and its complete immutable selected generation from the real server-owned source lease at test entry. Inject at the incumbent before_manifest_switch boundary (after generation and temporary-manifest validation), then observe the publisher's settled refusal and cleanup. The two protected resources are the exact visible manifest and entire incumbent selected generation tree; new staging, temporary manifest and unselected candidate generation are outside that protected population and have separate cleanup obligations. Same-actor write/mutation detection must cover the bounded interval, including mutate-then-restore, not merely equal endpoint bytes. All declarations here specify the future integration test; they are not observations or evidence of an executed capture. Post-switch/indeterminate effects, replay, restart, concurrency and orphan cleanup remain separate AC8 obligations.

AC6 structural sub-obligation: the planned package-owned artifact descriptor component exists as the usable naming/declaration provider exercised by the mapping test. This binds test-validity to the actual planned module and actual unit-test locus, replacing the unused generic profile-term scaffold binding; it is not AC14's coordinator inspection. The behavioral naming formulas, atomic migration of both consumers, all capture semantics and all other criteria retain separate obligations. A component-existence match alone earns no coverage for those requirements. The falsifier must remove the exercised descriptor capability at this actual module boundary and discriminate in the worker's declared test; file-text inspection and a fabricated runtime witness are forbidden.

The admitted test-validity@2.0.0 component/suite roles require profile_term identities; repository_path role bindings were diagnosed incompatible by bindings_inspect. These exact capability terms denote the planned package artifact descriptor and its mapping-test capability check, while the stable runtime proof remains bound to the actual capture-artifact-descriptor.mjs module. They are logical proof referents, not runtime identities, input fields or compatibility aliases. Retire the preceding unmatched repository-path existence/verification pair through semantic refactor after this replacement is authored. This only supplies AC6's descriptor-capability existence sub-obligation and test-validity's structural prerequisite; it does not discharge AC6's ownership/migration behavior or any other acceptance criterion.
